column1: # Controlled depressurisation of one channel: the operator lowers the low-pressurizer-pressure setpoint
# with the manual reset pushbutton after each 140 psi pressure step (setpoint = pressure - band)
# places the trip in operating bypass below the 400 psia permissive.  The trip must never actuate.
# At-power start: each channel's high log power trip is tripped on cycle 0 (fail-safe start-up) until its
# operating bypass is initiated by a button press on cycle 1 (a press held from power-up is ignored).
